entities.name: Carboxylic acid amidation
observations: The carboxylic acid terminus couples to a secondary piperidine nitrogen to form a C(=O)–N amide bond; the aryl chloride remains unchanged.

entities.name: EDCI-DIPEA-HOBt
observations: An analogous ORD record lists EDCI, DIPEA, HOBt, and DMF; HCl and water also appear among recorded components.
The record does not establish reaction temperature or time.
